complete.message: You tried every face challenge in this set! Keep playing and see what sounds you can find.

default.title: Smile time
default.message: Try a smile. Imagine your favourite song just came on.
default.hint: Gently lift the corners of your mouth and hold for a moment.
default.encouragement: A little smile is welcome too. Take your time.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Oh! A dragon!
default.message: Make an 'O' with your mouth. A tiny dragon just sneezed.
default.hint: Open your mouth into a gentle 'O' and let your smile relax.
default.encouragement: A tiny dragon only needs a little surprise.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Send a kiss
default.message: Pucker your lips, as if blowing a kiss.
default.hint: Gently bring your lips forward. You do not need to make a sound.
default.encouragement: Take your time. This kiss can travel at its own speed.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Secret signal
default.message: Try a wink, if it feels comfortable. Secret signal time.
default.hint: Close one eye while keeping the other open. Either eye can wink.
default.encouragement: Tricky one? You can let it pass and keep playing.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Time for mischief
default.message: Stick your tongue out gently. Very serious music-making.
default.hint: Let your tongue peek out. No need to stretch.
default.encouragement: A little silliness goes a long way.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Take a breather
default.message: Let your face relax. Even musicians take a breather.
default.hint: Let your mouth and eyebrows rest, with your eyes open.
default.encouragement: There is no hurry. Get comfy.
default.retryMessage: Let's try another one. We can come back to this.

default.title: Wow moment
default.message: Lift both eyebrows. Imagine the biggest cake you have ever seen.
default.hint: Raise both eyebrows with your eyes open and your mouth gently closed.

default.title: Sideways smile
default.message: Try a sideways smile. Lift one corner of your mouth.
default.hint: Let one corner of your mouth lift more than the other. Keep it gentle.
default.encouragement: A small sideways smile is plenty to try.
